home.heroSubtitle: Buy fresh produce, sell your harvest, and get expert advice — all in one platform.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one place
home.featureSellBody: Reach more buyers and set your own prices.
home.featureBuyBody: Order directly from farmers across Ethiopia.

about.title: About AgroLink
about.missionBody: To digitally connect every farmer in Ethiopia with buyers, service providers, and expert advisors — regardless of their digital literacy.
about.storyBody: AgroLink was created to bridge the gap between traditional agricultural practices and modern digital marketplaces.
about.teamBody: A committed team of developers, designers, agricultural specialists, and community organizers.
about.contactBody: For general inquiries, reach us at support@agrolink.et.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.farmerBody: Register, list products, manage orders, and connect with experts.
howItWorks.buyerBody: Browse, search, and order fresh products directly from farmers.
howItWorks.serviceProviderBody: Sell inputs or offer expert consultations to farmers.
howItWorks.supportAgentBody: Assist traditional farmers with registration and product listings.
howItWorks.administratorBody: Oversee the platform, moderate content, and ensure quality.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.headline: Free for farmers. Free for buyers.
pricing.description: AgroLink is free to use for farmers and buyers. Service providers may have optional premium features in the future.
pricing.freeBody: No registration fees, no listing fees, no commission on sales.
pricing.feesBody: Any future fees will be clearly communicated in advance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, AgroLink is free for farmers and buyers.
faq.a2: Click 'Sign up' and choose your role to get started.
faq.q3: Can I use AgroLink without a smartphone?
faq.a3: Yes — ask a Support Agent in your area to help you register.
faq.q4: How do I get expert advice?
faq.a4: Browse our Expert Directory and request a consultation.
faq.a5: Cash, bank transfer, Telebirr, and Chapa.
faq.q6: How do I report a problem?
faq.a6: Open a support ticket from your dashboard or contact our team.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you. Fill out the form below or email us directly.
contact.name: Your name

helpCenter.title: Help center
helpCenter.accountQ1: How do I reset my password?
helpCenter.accountA1: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page.
helpCenter.accountQ2: How do I update my profile?
helpCenter.accountA2: Go to Settings → Profile and edit your information.
helpCenter.accountQ3: How do I delete my account?
helpCenter.accountA3: Contact support to request account deletion.
helpCenter.ordersQ1: How do I track my order?
helpCenter.ordersA1: Open your Orders page and select an order to see its status.
helpCenter.ordersA2: Yes, before the seller confirms the order.
helpCenter.ordersQ3: What if the product is wrong?
helpCenter.ordersA3: Open a dispute from the order page.
helpCenter.paymentsA1: Cash, bank transfer, Telebirr, and Chapa.
helpCenter.paymentsA2: Yes. All transactions are recorded and verified.
helpCenter.paymentsQ3: How do I get a refund?
helpCenter.paymentsA3: Open a dispute or contact support.
helpCenter.consultationsQ1: How do I find an expert?
helpCenter.consultationsA1: Browse the Expert Directory from your dashboard.
helpCenter.consultationsQ3: What if the expert doesn't respond?
helpCenter.technicalA1: Check your internet connection and try again.
helpCenter.technicalA2: Please report it through the support form.
helpCenter.technicalA3: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge — latest versions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.body: By using AgroLink Ethiopia, you agree to these Terms of Service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectBody: We collect information you provide when registering, listing products, or communicating through the platform.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to operate the platform, connect buyers with farmers, and improve our services.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only as required to operate the platform.
privacy.assistedBody: When a Support Agent assists you, we record your consent and every action they take. You remain the owner of your data and listings.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal information.
privacy.securityBody: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, reach us at:
privacy.viewOnline: View full policy on our website

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.heading: Cookie & Local Storage Policy
cookies.introBody: Cookies are small files stored by your browser to remember your preferences.
cookies.mobileTitle: How the mobile app uses local storage
cookies.mobileBody: The AgroLink mobile app uses secure local storage for your session and preferences.
cookies.essentialBody: Required for login, session, and app security. Cannot be disabled.
cookies.analyticsBody: Optional. Helps us improve the app experience.
cookies.manageBody: You can clear app data from your device settings at any time.
cookies.clearBody: Clearing app data will log you out and reset preferences.
cookies.viewOnline: View full policy on our website

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.commitmentBody: AgroLink Ethiopia is committed to making agricultural services accessible to everyone.
accessibility.feature1: Screen reader support across all pages
accessibility.feature2: Adjustable text size that respects your browser settings
accessibility.feature3: High-contrast color options in dark mode
accessibility.feature5: Full English and Amharic language support
accessibility.languageBody: The platform supports both English and Amharic. You can switch languages at any time.
accessibility.assistedBody: Farmers who cannot independently use the platform can receive help from trained Support Agents.
accessibility.limitationsBody: Some older devices may experience slow performance.
accessibility.feedbackBody: Encountered an accessibility issue? Please let us know:
accessibility.viewOnline: View full statement on our website
